name: Blue Water-speedwell
desc: Blue Water-speedwell (Veronica anagallis-aquatica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Veronica anagallis-aquatica is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae known by the common names water speedwell, blue water-speedwell, and brook pimpernel.
